name: Saint Lucia

fees.name: Non-Immigrant Visa - Single Entry
fees.validity: Single entry, valid within a 3 month period
fees.applies: nationalities requiring a visa to enter Saint Lucia (most Commonwealth, EU, US, UK, and many other nationals are visa-exempt for short tourist stays; visa required for a limited list of nationalities)
fees.notes: Issued by the Royal Saint Lucia Police Force Immigration/Visa Office. Fee published in EC dollars (XCD); amount_usd is an approximate conversion at the fixed XCD/USD peg (~2.70 XCD = 1 USD).

fees.name: Non-Immigrant Visa - Multiple Entry
fees.validity: Multiple entries over a one year period
fees.applies: nationalities requiring a visa to enter Saint Lucia
fees.notes: Issued by the Royal Saint Lucia Police Force Immigration/Visa Office. Fee published in EC dollars (XCD); amount_usd is an approximate conversion at the fixed XCD/USD peg (~2.70 XCD = 1 USD).

free_visa_notes: Saint Lucia grants visa-free entry for tourism to the large majority of nationalities (including EU, UK, USA, Canada, most Commonwealth and Caribbean states), typically permitting stays of up to 6 weeks (per UK FCDO advice) or up to 90 days depending on nationality, granted on arrival at no charge. A visa (fee EC$125 single-entry / EC$190 multiple-entry) is only required for nationals of a specific list of countries not covered by visa-exempt status; no official, publicly itemised nationality-by-nationality fee schedule (i.e. no reciprocity fee schedule distinct from the flat EC$125/EC$190 rates) was found on official sources, and no e-visa, visa-on-arrival fee, eTA, or outsourced (VFS/TLScontact/BLS) visa processing centre exists for Saint Lucia as of this record's date.
